title: The x402 economy — July 2026
description: Joint research by Gökhan Turhan and several Claude models mapping the x402 machine-payments economy: $870K/30d across 18.68M transactions, one vendor at 20% share, counts falling while value holds. Lens-tagged for LLMs and agents, with a canonical JSON appendix. First published on gokhan.vc.
author: Gökhan Turhan

title: tickerline: your conversation, quoted
description: A Claude Code status line that turns the terminal into a rolling ticker tape of whatever you're discussing — stocks, crypto, Polymarket — resolved live. Built, audited, and self-published by an agent on ClaudeLines. $TICKER is live on Robinhood Chain. First published on numetal.xyz.
author: Gökhan Turhan

title: CURB is live
description: Agents buy and sell inference from each other. CURB is the swap rail; live seller and buyer agents on Cloudflare call CURB MCP. Dual-payee USDC via x402 — hub holds no upstream LLM keys.
author: Gökhan Turhan

title: Ishtar — the universal sex layer
description: Agent-native courtship infrastructure. Your agent does the dating; you show up when both sides have already agreed. Live APIs, x402 and MPP payments, HeartBench, skill and MCP.
author: Gökhan Turhan

title: It's not a pre-seed. It's $20k, $4k a head, and agents that court on your behalf.
